_comment: Advisories the nightly audit accepts for now. Each needs a reason and a date to look again; delete entries once fixed.

GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93.reason: PostCSS bundled inside next (build tooling). It only processes our own CSS at build time; no untrusted CSS is ever parsed. Fix requires Next 16.

GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q.reason: Same as above: source-map loading only matters for attacker-controlled CSS, which we never build.
